research_result.description: Mermaid CLI (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli) is an open-source command-line interface and Node.js library for converting Mermaid diagram definition files into SVG, PNG, or PDF output.
research_result.credential_requirements: No credentials or API keys are required. Mermaid CLI is an open-source tool installed and run locally via npm, npx, or Docker.

evidence.claim: Mermaid CLI is free, open-source software distributed under the MIT license.
Mermaid CLI provides a command-line interface to convert Mermaid diagram files into SVG, PNG, or PDF files.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: This is a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid. It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.

evidence.claim: An MCP server integration is available that uses Mermaid CLI for diagram validation and rendering.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Leverages the Mermaid CLI tool to perform diagram validation and rendering
